exposure: Delivery room continuous positive airway pressure (DR-CPAP)
outcome: Improvement or deterioration of labored breathing (Modified Downe's score)
cohort: Inborn, spontaneously breathing term neonates (gestational age >=36 weeks + 6 days to <41 weeks + 6 days) experiencing respiratory distress (Modified Downe's score >3 and <7) at birth.
finding: DR-CPAP led to recovery within 30 minutes for 76% of term neonates with respiratory distress and significantly reduced the need for subsequent mechanical ventilation and duration of NICU stay; a significant association was also found between delayed initiation of breastfeeding and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with NICU admission.
